title: Kompas Liceum
ogTitle: Kompas Liceum · jakie liceum w Krakowie?
description: A guide for Kraków 8th graders and their parents: from what the kid likes and is good at, to profiles, classes and high schools in Kraków. Polish.
ogDescription: Do przejścia razem z dzieckiem: od tego, co lubi i umie, do profili, klas i szkół w Krakowie. Pomaga zacząć rozmowę, nie podejmuje decyzji.
cardText: For 8th graders choosing a high school in Kraków, to go through together with a parent. Taps and sliders instead of typing lead to profiles on a compass, then to matching classes and schools on a map. It starts a conversation rather than making the decision, and nothing about the kid leaves the browser. Polish.
imageAlt: Kompas Liceum: a compass pointing from interests to high schools in Kraków
